blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Anti-narcotics operatives seized over P1.8 million worth of suspected shabu, and arrested two alleged drug peddlers during back-to-back buy-bust operations in Bukidnon and this city before dawn on Saturday, Sept. 19. Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) reported that the separate stings yielded a combined total of roughly 270.13 grams of illegal drugs with an estimated standard drug price of P1,836,884. The first sting was launched around 12:47 a.m. at Purok 6, Central Poblacion in Kalilangan, Bukidnon.
